discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 202642e: numstat records split on the first two tabs only and the remainder is kept as the filename, with a test for a tab-containing name.

Fixed in ac405ed: gitlink entries (mode 160000) are detected from the index/tree before reading anything, and previewed the way git diff shows them: 'Subproject commit <sha>' on each side (the working side is the submodule's checked-out HEAD). Covered for commit previews and working-tree previews with a real submodule in the test repo.

Fixed in ac405ed: the SSH listing now runs a small POSIX sh script (folder passed as a positional argument) whose [ -d ] test follows symlinks, so a link to a folder gets the trailing slash and expands like locally; dotfiles and dangling links are still listed. The script is executed for real in project-files.test.ts against a temp folder with a linked folder and a dangling link.

Fixed in 24f543400: the working side of a submodule now reads like git diff: its checked-out HEAD plus '-dirty' when it has uncommitted changes, so an edited-but-uncommitted submodule previews as 'Subproject commit <sha>' -> 'Subproject commit <sha>-dirty' instead of 'No textual changes'. It also checks the path is the submodule's own repository root first, so an uninitialized submodule can't report the superproject's HEAD. Covered in the real-submodule test.

Valid, fixed. A link whose target is a directory already on the current copy chain, or an ancestor of one (`.`, `..`, a sibling that links back), is now skipped and listed in `skippedPaths` instead of being expanded again, and the number of linked-directory expansions is capped (`MAX_LINK_EXPANSIONS`). Covered by "skips links that loop back into a directory being copied": twenty links to `.` plus one to `..` finish in well under a second with only the real content copied.

Fixed. An entry whose value is an inline scalar, like `disabled: true` or `disabled: false # note`, is now a single line, so an indented comment after it stays with the author. Block scalars (`|`, `>`) and nested values still take their indented continuation lines with them. Test added for both disabling and re-enabling.
